method: cycles/wall_us in MHz; fixed long runs: warmup100, ten consecutive300frame windows, no dropped windows, one microsecond timer interval uncertainty. Strict bound requires cycles*2 >= (wall_us+1)*7 and no deadline resync.
limitations: Rates use the onboard microsecond counter; no external oscillator calibration.

The final ordinary APP passed init/R before and after both diagnostic game runs. Both full 3000-frame spans meet the unchanged conservative 3.5MHz lower-bound predicate. Short-window rates and individual frame lateness are retained.

Cosmic Payback still has up to3515us frame lateness and356382 samples without sufficient published CPU history. AY continues rendering with the latest published registers; zero underruns or electrically verified audio quality are not claimed.
The Sword of Ianna is covered only by host state comparison.
The native keyboard-bitmap optimization in commit fb8b2603c passed host tests but is not installed: hardware still runs BUILD845BC1C3.
